column1: # The C ABI of libkomira. One row per export: symbol, return type, argument types, the version that added it.
# Types are Mojo's, origins dropped; see tools/build/mojo/abi_golden.bzl. Adding a row raises the minor version.
# Changing or removing one raises the major version (status.mojo: ABI_MAJOR, ABI_MINOR).
# Status codes (status.mojo): zero is success, every failure is negative.
# The longest byte input a call accepts: 64 MiB.
